title: Lena's referral
summary: Jordan applied for a product designer role at Northlight after Lena secured a referral, and spent the evening on the application expecting the portfolio update to be a slog—only to find the Meridian case studies were already solid, especially the Coda write-up, which turned into the strongest piece by honestly documenting how he'd missed his own blind spot as a user. He felt a quiet vindication in realizing Mika and Lena had been right all along about Coda's value, something he hadn't believed until he wrote it himself. He submitted the application at 11:20pm with a short, non-fawning cover letter, and closed the night calmly, ceding his pillow to Pepper the cat.
